LICENSE ACTIVATION INSTRUCTIONS
============================

The Billing System requires a valid license to run. Follow these steps to activate your license:

1. GET YOUR HARDWARE ID
   - Right-click on "GetHardwareId.ps1" and select "Run with PowerShell"
   - This will display your machine's unique Hardware ID
   - Copy this Hardware ID (it will look like: 37072A53F1F4132B)

2. GENERATE A LICENSE KEY
   - Right-click on "GenerateLicenseKey.ps1" and select "Run with PowerShell"
   - Enter the Hardware ID from step 1
   - Enter your Company Name
   - The script will generate a license key (e.g., ABCD-1234-EFGH-5678-IJKL)

3. ACTIVATE THE SOFTWARE
   - When you run the Billing System, it will show the License Activation form
   - Enter the license key generated in step 2
   - Enter the same Company Name you used in step 2
   - Enter your email address
   - Click "Activate"

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- The license is tied to your specific machine. If you move the software to another computer, you'll need a new license key.
- Keep your license key safe. You'll need it if you reinstall the software.
- The license file (license.dat) is stored in the same folder as the application.

For support, please contact your system administrator.
